name: ReportBench
intro: ReportBench是一个系统性基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的学术研究报告的内容质量。该基准关注两个关键维度：引用文献的质量和相关性，以及报告中陈述的忠实性和真实性。它利用arXiv上的高质量已发表综述论文作为黄金标准，通过逆向提示工程构建领域特定提示和评估语料库。
org: ByteDance, Beihang University, The University of Sydney
metric: 内容质量, 引用文献质量和相关性, 陈述忠实性和真实性
intro_en: ReportBench is a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate the content quality of academic research reports generated by large language models (LLMs). It focuses on two key dimensions: the quality and relevance of cited references, and the faithfulness and veracity of statements in the reports. It uses high-quality published survey papers from arXiv as the gold standard and employs reverse prompt engineering to construct domain-specific prompts and evaluation corpora.
metric_en: Content Quality, Citation Quality and Relevance, Statement Faithfulness and Truthfulness

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ReportBench arXiv:2508.15804 Sections 2.1-2.2 and Appendix, cross-checked against ByteDance-BandAI/ReportBench. ReportBench starts from a post-2020 arXiv snapshot, finds survey or review papers, verifies publication and survey status, parses LaTeX citations, and retains 678 expert-authored surveys with their bibliographies. It reverse-engineers sentence-, paragraph-, and detail-level research prompts under each survey's temporal cutoff, classifies domains, balances the distribution, and samples 100 tasks. Generated reports must not cite the source survey. Evaluation compares retrieved literature with the gold bibliography, extracts cited and uncited statements, checks cited claims against their sources, validates uncited claims with web evidence and multi-model voting, and reports citation coverage or overlap plus statement factuality.
